mapper.insert: INSERT INTO APV_LINE (submission_id, step_order, approver_id, approver_nm) VALUES (#{submissionId}, #{stepOrder}, #{approverId}, #{approverNm})
mapper.select: SELECT line_id, submission_id, step_order, approver_id, approver_nm, status, comment_cn, processed_at FROM APV_LINE WHERE submission_id = #{value} ORDER BY step_order
